About Kabad Factory

A cleaner, simpler way to sell recyclables from home.

Kabad Factory brings current scrap rates, doorstep pickup, saved addresses and order tracking into one easy digital experience for Gwalior customers.

Download App

Our Mission

Easy, transparent recycling — one doorstep at a time

Whether it is paper, metal, plastic, electronics, or household scrap, our goal is to help customers recycle responsibly without carrying scrap to a local dealer.

Effortless Doorstep Pickup

Schedule pickup from your home without carrying paper, metal, plastic, electronics, or household scrap to a local dealer.

Transparent Scrap Rates

View current prices and understand how your scrap value is calculated before the executive confirms final weight.

Digital Convenience

Manage pickups, saved addresses, order history, and account details through the website or Kabad Factory mobile app.

Responsible Recycling

Help keep recyclable material out of waste streams and put useful scrap back into productive circulation.

Our Vision

A cleaner city where selling scrap is as simple as ordering a service online.

Doorstep pickup from saved addresses
Current scrap rates from backend
Pickup charge before confirmation
Orders and bills in one account
